title: Ministries
body: Maintain the role catalog for ministries you lead. Retired roles stay on historical assignments but cannot be used for new ones.
signInRequired: Sign in to manage ministry roles.
notLeader: You must lead a ministry to manage its role catalog.
retireConfirm: Retire "{{name}}"? Retired roles stay on past assignments but cannot be used for new ones. To restore a retired role, contact your church administrator.
